messages:
maria_ops: Heads up — detecting rapid GPU node losses in eu-west2 P2 pool, 8/24 nodes offline, scheduler reports OOM+evictions. API 5xx up ~1.8% and tail latency spikes on generation routes.

samira_infra: on it, pulling node logs now. suspecting host-level kernel panic after recent kernel patch.

leo_sre: network flaps also showing on the hypervisor switch, forms of packet drops to the GPU hosts. ping/latency jitter from monitoring.

maria_ops: can we get immediate capacity steering? prefer soft controls first — avoid full fallback unless necessary.

ken_prod: note we have 3 enterprise customers on high-throughput reserved pools in that region. need per-customer limits to avoid one tenant taking all spare capacity.

samira_infra: agreed. proposal: apply temporary per-tenant soft token-bucket at 60% of baseline for tier=standard, 80% for enterprise; enable short-term queueing and 503-hinting to callers. would reduce spike while preserving inflight critical jobs.

leo_sre: +1. also recommend immediate traffic shift for stateless, low-latency routes to eu-west1 where possible. We'll add route policy in smart-router with region-weight shift 10->40 over 15m.

maria_ops: sounds good. roll order: 1) soft per-customer throttle 2) route weight shift 3) scale up other regions if autoscale can't keep up. keep customers in the loop.

ken_prod: what about cost for cross-region burst? notify finance/cost team — we may exceed reserved commit.

maria_ops: we'll annotate the incident with cost win/loss. immediate priority is user-facing reliability.

samira_infra: executing throttle patch now. config snippet: ```
# rate-limit override
region: eu-west2
policy: soft-throttle
overrides:
  tier: standard
  token_bucket_ratio: 0.6
  burst_capacity_tokens: 20
```

deploy-bot: rate-limit config v3 applied to eu-west2 (deploy-id: rl-20260318-9f2). changes live in ~15s.

incident-bot: alert: eu-west2 GPU host evictions increased by 320% in last 10m. automated scaling attempted 2x; pending capacity is 0.8x target.

leo_sre: observed immediate drop in sustained token consumption by ~38% after throttle deployed. 5xxs trending down.

maria_ops: start the region-weight shift now, target eu-west1 for stateless routes. samira, coordinate with smart-router.

samira_infra: kicking the weight shift: weight eu-west2=60%, eu-west1=40% over 10m. adding fail-open policy if eu-west1 latency > 150ms.

ken_prod: pinging account reps for the three affected customers to prewarn about soft throttles (they're not full hard caps, but they may see increased latencies).

leo_sre: miscellaneous note — one of the evicted hosts shows GPU driver crash with kernel oops referencing nv_peer_mem. filing ticket with cloud provider now.

maria_ops: good. next actions: 1) monitor 5xx and p95/p99 2) if 5xx > 3% revert weight shift and escalate to hard fallback 3) prepare cross-region scaleup runbook. keep thread updated.

ken_prod: tracker: please tag any customer-facing comms with #customers-impacting and include ETA for changes.

samira_infra: will add runbook link and set small canary of traffic to eu-west1 before full shift.

deploy-bot: smart-router policy update applied (policy-id: sr-20260318-4b). gradual shift started.

incident-bot: metric update (5m): 5xx = 1.2% -> 0.7%, p99 gen latency down 18%.

maria_ops: thanks team. leaving this thread open — update when kernel vendor responds or if we need to escalate to DR. :white_check_mark:

leo_sre: vendor replied — driver patch queued, ETA 3h for validated image. keeping cluster scaled down until then.

maria_ops: ok, keep soft throttle active for 3h and re-evaluate after patch.

ken_prod: will draft short note for impacted customers.

samira_infra: noted. closing monitoring loop for now, will post follow-ups.
